title: NASA tries to replicate Podkletnov's weight loss effect
summary: Nick Cook tells of NASA tries to replicate Podkletnov's weight loss effect, about mid-1990s at University of Tampere, Finland; NASA, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: NASA had exhibited, weirdly, an interest in anti-gravity in the sort of mid-1990s following reports that a guy He was a Russian called a Yevgeny Podkletnov

plain: Nick Cook, a journalist who writes about aviation and secret aircraft, says NASA, the US space agency, oddly took an interest in anti-gravity, meaning technology that cancels or reduces gravity, in the mid-1990s. According to Cook, this followed reports from a Russian scientist named Yevgeny Podkletnov, working at the University of Tampere in Finland, that objects seemed to lose weight in his experiments, and NASA tried to repeat the effect. If true, it would mean a government agency took a real way to beat gravity seriously.
